title: 第9章 老头吓死了
content_zh:
中国医学科学院。杨波三人对刘济民佩服不已，李卫国平时喜欢听《三国演义》，他将食堂的冲突比喻为诸葛亮骂王朗，诸葛亮自然就是刘济民。

    不过兴奋过后，三人心中不免再次涌起一丝失落。尽管骂战骂赢了，但是对方口中的“文盲”二字，仍然深深刺痛了几人的心。一想到“文盲上大学”的标签要贴在自己身上一辈子，他们的身子不自觉地就矮了一截。

    杨波心里十分不忿，他认为他的文化水平并不比这些高考生差。只不过政策不允许在校工农兵大学生参加高考，要不然他一定去考一次。

    众人身后的梁满囤一边附和几人，一边俯身从路旁抓了一把细沙放进了餐盒里。

    洗饭盒没有洗洁精，抓一把细沙放在餐盒里，能够通过磨擦把餐盒里的油给洗掉。

    不过满囤打的饭菜油水不大，就算不用细沙也能洗个大概。

    宿舍水房，众人洗完饭盒之后，双手冻得通红，刘济民更是将双手夹在腋下取暖。

    “还是我们钢厂好，我们钢厂那嘎达热水多，洗脸我们都是用热水。”来自鞍钢的李卫国怀念地说道。

    每次洗手、洗饭盒的时候，刘济民都能听到类似的话，李卫国从骨子里透露出对鞍钢的那种热爱，甚至带着一丝狂热。

    刘济民冲着水房右边的小门努了努嘴：“去里面，里面是热水！”

    每层楼都有一个水房，水房和厕所相连，不过中间隔了一道墙。跨过这道墙，就跟打开了尿素化肥袋一样，那味道直冲天灵盖。

    “哈哈哈哈！”顿时水房里笑声一片，有人不嫌事大吆喝着要给李卫国放点热水。

    “去去去，一群彪子，就你们那小玩意儿，温度和水量能跟我们厂的高炉比吗？”李卫国挺胸抬头，用手拉了一下工装下摆，将左胸挂着的铁制红底金字的鞍钢厂徽大方地展示给众人。

    “赶紧走吧，要上课了！”不知道谁喊了一句。

    每天八点二十上课，安排四到六节课，其余时间为自由安排。76级的工农兵大学生跟往届相比，有一个非常明显的变化就是政治生活所占比重大大下降，也不需要去工厂、生产队、军队参加学工学农学军的实践活动了。

    在以往，学生要轮流去参加“三学活动”。上学期间，30%以上的是政治生活，上学看报骂孔老二。

    当然，骂的不止是孔老二。

    如今知识学习占据主流，工农兵学员在课下，也是一个个如饥似渴地学习。

    “今天咱们学习传染病防治，一旦发现传染病之后怎么办？”课堂上，老教授转身在黑板上写下“传染病防治”几个大字。

    “立即将传染源隔离起来！”

    “接下来呢？”
content_en:
Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences. Yang Bo and the other three admired Liu Jimin. Li Weiguo usually liked to listen to "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms". He compared the conflict in the cafeteria to Zhuge Liang scolding Wang Lang. Zhuge Liang was naturally Liu Jimin.

    However, after the excitement, the three of them couldn't help but feel a little disappointed again. Although they won the scolding battle, the word "illiteracy" in the other party's mouth still deeply hurt the hearts of several people. When they think about the label of "illiterates going to college" that will be attached to them for the rest of their lives, they unconsciously become shorter.

    Yang Bo felt very unhappy. He believed that his cultural level was no worse than those of these college entrance examination students. It's just that the policy does not allow workers, peasants and soldiers college students to take the college entrance examination, otherwise he must take it once.

    Liang Mantun, who was behind the crowd, echoed a few others while leaning over to grab a handful of fine sand from the roadside and put it into the lunch box.

    There is no detergent to wash the lunch box. Grab a handful of fine sand and put it in the lunch box. The oil in the lunch box can be washed away through friction.

    However, the food that is packed with food is not very oily and watery, so it can be washed roughly even without fine sand.

    In the dormitory water room, after everyone washed their lunch boxes, their hands were red from the cold. Liu Jimin even put his hands under his armpits to keep warm.

    "Our steel plant is better. Our steel plant has a lot of hot water in Nagada. We always use hot water to wash our faces." Li Weiguo from Anshan Iron and Steel said nostalgically.

    Liu Jimin could hear similar words every time he washed his hands and lunch boxes. Li Weiguo revealed his deep love for Anshan Iron and Steel, even with a hint of fanaticism.

    Liu Jimin pursed his lips at the small door on the right side of the water room: "Go inside, there is hot water inside!"

    There is a water room on each floor. The water room is connected to the toilet, but separated by a wall. Stepping over this wall is like opening a bag of urea fertilizer, and the smell goes straight to Tianling Gai.

    "Hahahaha!" Suddenly there was laughter in the water room, and someone shouted to put some hot water for Li Weiguo.

    "Go, go, you bunch of bastards, can your gadgets have a temperature and water volume comparable to our factory's blast furnace?" Li Weiguo raised his chest and raised his head, pulled the hem of his work clothes with his hand, and showed the Anshan Iron and Steel Factory emblem with red background and gold letters hanging on his left chest to everyone.

    "Let's go quickly, class is about to begin!" Someone shouted.

    Classes start at 8:20 every day, with four to six classes scheduled, and the rest of the time can be arranged freely. Compared with the previous batch of workers, peasants and soldiers college students in the 76th grade, one very obvious change is that the proportion of political life has been greatly reduced, and they no longer need to go to factories, production teams, or the army to participate in practical activities of studying engineering, agriculture, and the military.

    In the past, students had to take turns to participate in the "three studies activities". When I was in school, more than 30% of my time was in political life. When I went to school, I read newspapers and scolded Kong Laoer.

    Of course, it wasn't just Kong Laoer who was scolded.

    Nowadays, knowledge learning occupies the mainstream, and workers, peasants and soldiers students are also studying eagerly after class.

    "Today we are learning about the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. What should we do once an infectious disease is discovered?" In class, the old professor turned around and wrote the words "Infectious Disease Prevention and Control" on the blackboard.

    "Isolate the source of infection immediately!"

    "What's next?"
title_en: Chapter 9 The old man was scared to death
